parts.name: Fuel Tank
parts.description: The Rebel's signature peanut-shaped steel tank, which holds 3.0 US gallons.
parts.function: Stores the gasoline that the fuel pump delivers to the injectors. Its painted exterior is also the bike's main styling panel.

parts.name: Fuel Pump
parts.description: An electric pump that pressurizes fuel for the injection system. Its location and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
parts.function: Delivers fuel at a regulated pressure to the injectors whenever the engine is running or being started.
parts.verificationNote: PGM-FI fuel injection is confirmed by Honda. The pump's location, part number and diagram are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: PGM-FI Fuel Injection
parts.function: An electronic control unit reads sensors such as throttle position and engine speed and fires the injectors for the right amount of fuel on every intake stroke.

parts.name: Throttle Bodies (34 mm)
parts.description: Two throttle bodies, one per cylinder, with 34 mm bores. Their position in the 3D view is representative.
parts.function: A butterfly valve inside each throttle body opens as you twist the throttle, letting more air into the engine. The injection system adds fuel in proportion.

parts.name: Fuel Injectors
parts.description: Electrically operated nozzles that spray fuel into the intake.
parts.function: Atomize a precisely timed, precisely metered fuel charge for each cylinder.
parts.verificationNote: Injector count, position and part numbers are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.

parts.name: Air Cleaner
parts.description: The airbox and filter element that feed the throttle bodies. Location and part number are not yet verified for 2026 CMX500A.
parts.function: Filters dust out of the intake air so it cannot wear the cylinders and valves.
